create_async_loop: create an AsyncLoop with env_factory, agent_factory, controller, and running_phase to run RL episodes asynchronously
run_async_loop: run an AsyncLoop instance to execute RL episodes in an asyncio event loop with episode callbacks
create_parallel_loop: create a ParallelLoop with env_factory, agent_factory, controller, and num_workers to distribute rollouts across processes
run_parallel_loop: run a ParallelLoop to start and join multiple AsyncLoop processes for parallel RL episode collection
create_loop_list: create a LoopList to manage and orchestrate multiple Loop instances with start, join, and terminate methods
